features.title: Invoice List Management with Pagination, Sorting, Search, View/Edit, Void, and Refresh
features.description: Enables accounts receivable staff to browse the full invoice list with client-side pagination (75 records per page), sort by any column, select rows for detail viewing or editing, apply search filters, void invoices with confirmation, and refresh data from the database.
features.source: SRS UIBlueprint frminvoice (VB6 Form), S.5 Events #1-#15

functions.label: Display paginated list of all invoices (Form_Load)
functions.description: When the form opens, it retrieves all invoices from the database, organizes them into pages of 75 invoices each, and displays them in the list. This provides accounts receivable staff with an immediate, browsable overview of invoices to begin their work.

functions.label: Open selected invoice for editing (lvList_DblClick)
functions.description: Double-clicking an invoice in the list checks that the record still exists and then opens the invoice in edit mode. This allows users to quickly access and modify invoice details directly from the list view.

functions.label: View or edit the selected invoice (Toolbar View/Edit)
functions.description: Clicking the View/Edit toolbar button opens the selected invoice in a read-only view if it is active, or in an editable mode if it is deactivated. This ensures staff can review active invoices safely while allowing corrections to draft or voided invoices.

functions.label: Search invoices using filter criteria (Toolbar Search)
functions.description: Clicking the Search button launches a modal search window where users can define filter conditions. Applying the filter narrows down the invoice list to only those records matching the criteria, helping staff quickly find specific invoices.

functions.label: Void the selected invoice with confirmation (Toolbar Void)
functions.description: The void function first verifies the invoice exists and is not locked by another user. After a confirmation prompt, it permanently deletes the invoice record; if related records exist, the system prevents the void and alerts the user, safeguarding against accidental data integrity breaches.

functions.label: Refresh invoice list from database (Toolbar Refresh)
functions.description: Clicking Refresh resets any active filters and reloads the complete invoice list directly from the database. This ensures that the displayed data is up-to-date, reflecting any recent additions or changes made by other users.

results.module_business_description: Provides comprehensive invoice viewing, search, and navigation capabilities, enabling users to retrieve and review customer-specific invoice details with pagination and sorting.

features.title: Invoice Add/Edit with Line-Item Management and Audit Trail
features.description: Enables sales users to create new invoices or modify existing ones: enter header details, add/remove product line items with price validation, apply payment terms (cash/credit/post-dated check), view payment history and modification audit, and persist the invoice transaction atomically.
features.source: SRS UIBlueprint frminvoiceae (VB6 form), S.5 events #1–#8 including form load, save, cancel, product add/remove, charge account toggle, payment history, and modification history.

functions.label: Prepare the invoice form for entry or review (Form_Load)
functions.description: When the invoice form opens, it binds dropdown lists, sets defaults, and generates a new invoice number for creation, or loads existing invoice data in view mode, disabling editing to prevent changes. All necessary lookup data is populated, and a warning message appears in view mode to inform the user that the record is read-only.

functions.label: Save invoice with line items and handle payments (cmdSave_Click)
functions.description: Validates mandatory fields, opens the post-dated check manager if needed, and updates the customer's status. Begins a database transaction, saves the invoice header and all product line items together, commits on success, and then offers the user to create another invoice or close the form, with a rollback on any error.

functions.label: Add product line to invoice grid with duplicate check (btnSold_Click)
functions.description: When the user selects a product and enters a valid sales price greater than zero, the system checks if the product already exists in the line grid. If it does, it prompts to replace the existing line; if not, it adds the new row, updates running totals and discounts, and resets the entry fields for the next addition.

functions.label: Remove a product line and update totals (btnRemove_Click)
functions.description: Removes the selected product row from the invoice grid, deducting its amount and discount from the running invoice totals. After removal, the remove button is hidden and the display refreshes to reflect the updated line items.

functions.label: Toggle payment method fields based on charge type (cbCA_Click)
functions.description: When the user selects "Credit" as the charge type, billing and payment fields become visible for data entry. Choosing "Cash" hides those fields and clears any entered values, streamlining the form for a cash transaction.

functions.label: View invoice creation audit details (cmdUsrHistory_Click)
functions.description: Shows who created the invoice and when, retrieving the information from the main recordset. It handles null values gracefully, providing a simple read-only display of the invoice's audit trail to support traceability.

functions.label: Close the invoice form without saving (cmdCancel_Click)
functions.description: Discards any unsaved changes and unloads the invoice form. In view mode, the button reads "Close" and performs the same action, allowing the user to exit the read-only view.

functions.label: Open payment history for the current invoice (cmdPH_Click)
functions.description: Opens a separate form that displays the payment history associated with this invoice, using the invoice's primary key to retrieve the relevant records. This provides users with quick access to past payment information without leaving the invoice context.

business_context.current_state: A VB6 form (frminvoiceae) where sales operators enter invoice headers (number, salesman, customer, payment terms), manage product line items in a grid, apply credit/cash/post-dated-check options, and save the invoice as a transactional unit with customer status updates and audit trail. View mode disables editing and loads existing invoice data.
business_context.target_state: A React invoice editor page (<InvoiceEditor />) backed by POST /api/v1/invoices and PUT /api/v1/invoices/{id}, with a child <LineItemsGrid /> component, real‑time tax/ discount calculations, and a dedicated <PDCManager /> modal for post‑dated check workflow. All operations run inside an atomic server‑side transaction with optimistic UI updates.

success_criteria: All database operations in the save flow must execute within an atomic transaction with full rollback on any error (implied from legacy code’s BeginTrans/CommitTrans/RollbackTrans behavior).
All user-supplied inputs, especially those used in dynamic SQL statements, must be parameterised to prevent SQL injection (unparameterised ADO Recordset operations detected in legacy code).
Invoice creation and modification must be recorded in an audit log with user identity, timestamp, and before/after values for future regulatory compliance.
